comparison.objective: Candidate screens media from finished washers; PR measures tyre tread depth with a pen gauge and returns the gauge to its rest.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests pouring, bimanual screen motion, and bridge clearing; PR tests narrow-probe placement, flat-foot contact, preserving a friction-held reading, and careful tool replacement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades recovered mass, workpiece retention, losses, damage, and released screen dwell; PR requires valid groove-floor seating, reading within 0.8 mm, gauge placement on its rest, release, and 1 s stillness.
comparison.reason: Granular separation and retained-workpiece control are not equivalent to contact metrology with a persistent gauge reading; both outcomes are adequately quantified.
